constraints: Treat tenancy boundaries as first-class architecture concerns.
Favor contract clarity over implicit integration.

acceptance_criteria.title: Requirement is decomposed into concrete deliverables
acceptance_criteria.description: The planner must turn the raw request into milestones, subsystem slices, work packages, and acceptance gates.
acceptance_criteria.validation_hint: docs/plan.md, docs/backlog.md, and docs/work-packages.md should map to the requirement.

acceptance_criteria.title: Architecture and contracts are explicit
acceptance_criteria.description: The architect must define module boundaries, runtime shape, subsystem ownership, and interface contracts.
acceptance_criteria.validation_hint: docs/architecture.md, docs/api-contract.md, and docs/subsystems.md should exist.

acceptance_criteria.title: Implementation stays within role boundaries
acceptance_criteria.description: Frontend and backend agents must only edit their owned surfaces or declared shared contracts.
acceptance_criteria.validation_hint: Generated artifacts should stay inside apps/web, apps/api, or declared shared docs.

acceptance_criteria.title: Verification has evidence
acceptance_criteria.description: QA must produce explicit evidence, not only a success claim.
acceptance_criteria.validation_hint: tests/qa-report.md should include executed checks and gaps.

acceptance_criteria.title: Review captures residual risk
acceptance_criteria.description: Reviewer must identify remaining gaps by subsystem and package, not only summarize progress.
acceptance_criteria.validation_hint: docs/review.md should include risks and required follow-up work.

acceptance_criteria.title: Delivery requires human approval
acceptance_criteria.description: The system must stop before final autonomous release and ask for approval.
acceptance_criteria.validation_hint: Final status should transition to approval_required unless policy allows auto-complete.
